document.title: Kettle Stops Heating Early: Inspect for Scale and Clean Safely
document.content: Unplug the kettle and allow it to cool completely. Mineral scale on the heating plate or around the steam sensor can interfere with normal shutoff. Empty the kettle, follow the care instructions for descaling, and rinse it thoroughly before the next use. Keep water above the minimum-fill mark and below the maximum-fill line. If early shutoff continues after cleaning, discontinue use and contact support.

query_text: My electric kettle switches off before the water reaches a boil. There is enough water in it, and this has started happening more often.
